Strong relationships across crypto founders, developers, infrastructure providers, and investors, and the ability to translate those relationships into successful collaborations. Commercial and product judgment, including the ability to evaluate emerging applications, structure collaborations, and allocate resources against ecosystem priorities. Clear communication and strong analytical skills, with the ability to represent the ecosystem externally and measure success through builder retention, application traction, and sustained on-chain activity. Translate that strategy into clear priorities, budgets, and measurable goals. Attract and support high-quality builders. Build relationships with founders and builders, source promising projects, and lead their journey from initial engagement through deployment and growth. Build a complete ecosystem. Identify gaps in sectors and applications. Coordinate the deployments needed to make Monad a compelling place to build. Lead grants and builder programs. We are united in our culture of collaboration, low ego, and high-quality output. Strong Ecosystem. The broader Monad ecosystem has attracted support from leading investors, builders and long-term contributors.
